item.text: {"searches":[{"reason":"The low sampled-negative error rates do not establish top-of-list quality. Find practical probes comparing uniform, training-frequency-matched and title/description-neighbor distractors using training-only prefix–next-item examples. Report candidate provenance, false-negative ambiguity, history-length and item-frequency support, and chunked full-catalog target ranks. These are diagnostic stress tests; keep the pinned validation evaluator and macro HR@10 selection unchanged.","query":"sequential recommendation diagnostic evaluation sampled negatives versus full catalog ranking hard negative false negatives popularity stratified rank reliability 2024 2025 2026"},{"reason":"Turn qualitative feedback into auditable recommendation-level evidence: explicit immediate connection, reported duplication, unresolved compatibility, and insufficient item identity. Seek grounded annotation protocols with source snippets, unknown labels, independent agreement checks and within-user preference inversions. Use only histories, timestamps, titles/descriptions and supplied feedback; distinguish reported concerns from verified incompatibility or satisfied needs. Summarize the twenty training users separately from validation evidence.","query":"recommendation explanation evaluation user feedback grounded annotation immediate intent redundancy compatibility uncertainty preference inversion top ranked items 2024 2025 2026"},{"reason":"Move beyond aggregate perturbation sensitivity toward locating actionable failures in NextItNet residual blocks and dilation scales. Find controlled activation interventions and synthetic temporal tasks that distinguish recent-pattern retrieval, stale-history interference and padding artifacts. Calibrate probes against known injected faults and harmless transformations, measuring detection and false alarms before using them to motivate training changes. All interventions operate on one trained NextItNet per category; no fitted auxiliary predictor or score fusion.","query":"causal dilated convolution sequential recommendation NextItNet activation patching residual block attribution diagnostic calibration synthetic temporal tasks fault injection 2024 2025 2026"}]}
